info.title: KANAKU Backend API
info.description:
# KANAKU Personal Finance API

**185 operations** across **148 paths** — fully documented end-to-end.

## Authenticate
1. `POST /api/v1/auth/register` or `POST /api/v1/auth/login`
2. Copy the JWT from the `Authorization` response header
3. Click **Authorize 🔓** → enter: `Bearer <token>`

## Roles
| Role | Access |
|------|--------|
| `user` | Personal finance |
| `advisor` | User + advisor workspace |
| `manager` | Advisor verification |
| `admin` | Full system access |

## Rate Limits
| Scope | Limit |
|-------|-------|
| /auth/* | 5/min |
| /bills POST | 10/min |
| /receipts/scan | 8/min |
| /sync/* | 100/min |
| All other | 60/min (prod) |
